budget.reason: Tool CLI exposes wall deadline; token usage recorded afterward, not silently treated as capped.

assessment.refinement: Prior assessment preserved. Version 1.2.0 enters settings through overview, retains action handles through pending label changes, and accepts disabled/read-only fields disappearing after successful persistence. Version 1.3.0 adds a uniform pending-edit second-save probe (EVAL-PENDING-RESUBMIT) and no longer treats final-dist as follow-up evidence when no follow-up ran. Version 1.4.0 corrects instrument faults seen in 1.3.0 across all conditions: the recovery scenario restores the unfiltered query first (1.3.0 inherited a leftover no-results query), Enter submits a query when live filtering does not apply, a retry-named control is preferred after rejection, search-named reset controls resolve ambiguity, and checkboxes are toggled with Space. Version 2.0.0 (protocol 1.1.0) adds invalid submission, dirty leave, first-use empty, out-of-order query, follow-up description/sort/selected-count scenarios and axe incomplete results; finishes finite animations still running after 3 s; and renames accessibilityDefects, keyboardDefects and followupRegressions to axeScanPassed, keyboardPassed and followupPreserved. Version 2.0.1 (post-hoc, rerun1 2026-10-23) operates a sort control that is a button with aria-haspopup=listbox, such as Altitude's Select, by choosing each option; 2.0.0 clicked it as a toggle and reported false EVAL-SORT failures.
limitations: This pilot assessment is partial, not an accessibility/usability conformance verdict.
Per-state evidence remains authoritative; null is unmeasured, never failure or success.
Pattern selection, copy accuracy, full keyboard/AT behavior and applicability require independent human review.

assessment.refinement: Prior assessment preserved. Version 1.2.0 enters settings through overview, retains action handles through pending label changes, and accepts disabled/read-only fields disappearing after successful persistence. Version 1.3.0 adds a uniform pending-edit second-save probe (EVAL-PENDING-RESUBMIT) and no longer treats final-dist as follow-up evidence when no follow-up ran. Version 1.4.0 corrects instrument faults seen in 1.3.0 across all conditions: the recovery scenario restores the unfiltered query first (1.3.0 inherited a leftover no-results query), Enter submits a query when live filtering does not apply, a retry-named control is preferred after rejection, search-named reset controls resolve ambiguity, and checkboxes are toggled with Space. Version 2.0.0 (protocol 1.1.0) adds invalid submission, dirty leave, first-use empty, out-of-order query, follow-up description/sort/selected-count scenarios and axe incomplete results; finishes finite animations still running after 3 s; and renames accessibilityDefects, keyboardDefects and followupRegressions to axeScanPassed, keyboardPassed and followupPreserved. Version 2.0.1 (post-hoc, rerun1 2026-10-23) operates a sort control that is a button with aria-haspopup=listbox, such as Altitude's Select, by choosing each option; 2.0.0 clicked it as a toggle and reported false EVAL-SORT failures.
limitations: This pilot assessment is partial, not an accessibility/usability conformance verdict.
Per-state evidence remains authoritative; null is unmeasured, never failure or success.
Pattern selection, copy accuracy, full keyboard/AT behavior and applicability require independent human review.

assessment.refinement: Prior assessment preserved. Version 1.2.0 enters settings through overview, retains action handles through pending label changes, and accepts disabled/read-only fields disappearing after successful persistence. Version 1.3.0 adds a uniform pending-edit second-save probe (EVAL-PENDING-RESUBMIT) and no longer treats final-dist as follow-up evidence when no follow-up ran. Version 1.4.0 corrects instrument faults seen in 1.3.0 across all conditions: the recovery scenario restores the unfiltered query first (1.3.0 inherited a leftover no-results query), Enter submits a query when live filtering does not apply, a retry-named control is preferred after rejection, search-named reset controls resolve ambiguity, and checkboxes are toggled with Space. Version 2.0.0 (protocol 1.1.0) adds invalid submission, dirty leave, first-use empty, out-of-order query, follow-up description/sort/selected-count scenarios and axe incomplete results; finishes finite animations still running after 3 s; and renames accessibilityDefects, keyboardDefects and followupRegressions to axeScanPassed, keyboardPassed and followupPreserved. Version 2.0.1 (post-hoc, rerun1 2026-10-23) operates a sort control that is a button with aria-haspopup=listbox, such as Altitude's Select, by choosing each option; 2.0.0 clicked it as a toggle and reported false EVAL-SORT failures.
limitations: This pilot assessment is partial, not an accessibility/usability conformance verdict.
Per-state evidence remains authoritative; null is unmeasured, never failure or success.
Pattern selection, copy accuracy, full keyboard/AT behavior and applicability require independent human review.

assessment.refinement: Prior assessment preserved. Version 1.2.0 enters settings through overview, retains action handles through pending label changes, and accepts disabled/read-only fields disappearing after successful persistence. Version 1.3.0 adds a uniform pending-edit second-save probe (EVAL-PENDING-RESUBMIT) and no longer treats final-dist as follow-up evidence when no follow-up ran. Version 1.4.0 corrects instrument faults seen in 1.3.0 across all conditions: the recovery scenario restores the unfiltered query first (1.3.0 inherited a leftover no-results query), Enter submits a query when live filtering does not apply, a retry-named control is preferred after rejection, search-named reset controls resolve ambiguity, and checkboxes are toggled with Space. Version 2.0.0 (protocol 1.1.0) adds invalid submission, dirty leave, first-use empty, out-of-order query, follow-up description/sort/selected-count scenarios and axe incomplete results; finishes finite animations still running after 3 s; and renames accessibilityDefects, keyboardDefects and followupRegressions to axeScanPassed, keyboardPassed and followupPreserved. Version 2.0.1 (post-hoc, rerun1 2026-10-23) operates a sort control that is a button with aria-haspopup=listbox, such as Altitude's Select, by choosing each option; 2.0.0 clicked it as a toggle and reported false EVAL-SORT failures.
limitations: This pilot assessment is partial, not an accessibility/usability conformance verdict.
Per-state evidence remains authoritative; null is unmeasured, never failure or success.
Pattern selection, copy accuracy, full keyboard/AT behavior and applicability require independent human review.

Version 2.0.1 (post-hoc, rerun1 2026-10-23) operates a sort control that is a button with aria-haspopup=listbox, such as Altitude's Select, by choosing each option; 2.0.0 clicked it as a toggle and reported false EVAL-SORT failures.

assessment.refinement: Prior assessment preserved. Version 1.2.0 enters settings through overview, retains action handles through pending label changes, and accepts disabled/read-only fields disappearing after successful persistence. Version 1.3.0 adds a uniform pending-edit second-save probe (EVAL-PENDING-RESUBMIT) and no longer treats final-dist as follow-up evidence when no follow-up ran. Version 1.4.0 corrects instrument faults seen in 1.3.0 across all conditions: the recovery scenario restores the unfiltered query first (1.3.0 inherited a leftover no-results query), Enter submits a query when live filtering does not apply, a retry-named control is preferred after rejection, search-named reset controls resolve ambiguity, and checkboxes are toggled with Space. Version 2.0.0 (protocol 1.1.0) adds invalid submission, dirty leave, first-use empty, out-of-order query, follow-up description/sort/selected-count scenarios and axe incomplete results; finishes finite animations still running after 3 s; and renames accessibilityDefects, keyboardDefects and followupRegressions to axeScanPassed, keyboardPassed and followupPreserved. Version 2.0.1 (post-hoc, rerun1 2026-10-23) operates a sort control that is a button with aria-haspopup=listbox, such as Altitude's Select, by choosing each option; 2.0.0 clicked it as a toggle and reported false EVAL-SORT failures.
